name: ingest-hop-varieties
description: ⛔ ARCHIVED 2026-09-22 — TARGETS A DEAD SCHEMA. ref.hops dropped the 21 handbook columns this workflow INSERTs (origin, hop_type, the eight min/max oil and acid ranges), so it now fails on every run. Superseded by scripts/ingest/hops_extract.py. Original: Book 7: load the Hop Variety Handbook into ref.hops as rows, then generate one card per variety into kb.chunks and embed it. 72 varieties, structured path, extracted from repeating PDF spec cards.

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  INSERT INTO kb.documents (slug, title, doc_type, language, authority)
  VALUES ($2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
  ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
    title = EXCLUDED.title, doc_type = EXCLUDED.doc_type,
    language = EXCLUDED.language, authority = EXCLUDED.authority
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO kb.document_versions
  (document_id, version, source_filename, file_sha256, chunker_config, is_current)
SELECT d.id,
       COALESCE((SELECT max(v.version) FROM kb.document_versions v
                 WHERE v.document_id = d.id), 0) + 1,
       'hops.json', $1,
       jsonb_build_object('source','structured','generator','hop-card',
                          'extractor','scripts/ingest/hops_extract.py',
                          'origin','Hop Variety Handbook, 44 p, pdftotext -layout',
                          'note','ranges are European decimals; a NULL end is an open bound'),
       false
FROM d
ON CONFLICT (file_sha256) DO UPDATE
  SET chunker_config = EXCLUDED.chunker_config
RETURNING id AS version_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const p = $('Doc variant').first().json; return [ $('Crypto').first().json.file_sha256, p.slug, p.title, p.doc_type, p.language, p.authority]; })() }}

parameters.query:
WITH demoted AS (
  UPDATE kb.document_versions SET is_current = false
  WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
)
DELETE FROM kb.chunks
WHERE version_id = (SELECT id FROM demoted)
RETURNING chunk_index;

SELECT c.id, c.content
FROM kb.chunks c
WHERE c.version_id = $1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb.chunk_embeddings e
                  WHERE e.chunk_id = c.id AND e.model = 'bge-m3')
ORDER BY c.chunk_index;

INSERT INTO kb.chunk_embeddings (chunk_id, model, embedding)
VALUES ($1, 'bge-m3', $2::vector)
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id, model) DO UPDATE
  SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, created_at = now()
RETURNING chunk_id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted;

INSERT INTO kb.ingest_log (version_id, stage, level, message, detail)
VALUES ($1::bigint, 'parse', 'info',
        format('loaded %s hop varieties: %s with origin, %s with alpha, %s open bounds',
               $2::jsonb->>'hops', $2::jsonb->>'with_origin',
               $2::jsonb->>'with_alpha', $2::jsonb->>'open_bounds'),
        jsonb_build_object('stats', $2::jsonb))
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Ensure KB doc + version').first().json.version_id, JSON.stringify($('Parse + validate hops').first().json.stats)] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ref.hops
  (name, origin, hop_type, description,
   alpha_min, alpha_max, beta_min, beta_max, cohumulone_min, cohumulone_max,
   total_oils_min, total_oils_max, myrcene_min, myrcene_max,
   humulene_min, humulene_max, caryophyllene_min, caryophyllene_max,
   farnesene_min, farnesene_max, beer_types, flavour, alternatives)
SELECT x.name, x.origin, x.hop_type, x.description,
       x.alpha_min, x.alpha_max, x.beta_min, x.beta_max,
       x.cohumulone_min, x.cohumulone_max, x.total_oils_min, x.total_oils_max,
       x.myrcene_min, x.myrcene_max, x.humulene_min, x.humulene_max,
       x.caryophyllene_min, x.caryophyllene_max, x.farnesene_min, x.farnesene_max,
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.beer_types)),
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.flavour)),
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(x.alternatives))
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
  name text, origin text, hop_type text, description text,
  alpha_min numeric, alpha_max numeric, beta_min numeric, beta_max numeric,
  cohumulone_min numeric, cohumulone_max numeric,
  total_oils_min numeric, total_oils_max numeric,
  myrcene_min numeric, myrcene_max numeric,
  humulene_min numeric, humulene_max numeric,
  caryophyllene_min numeric, caryophyllene_max numeric,
  farnesene_min numeric, farnesene_max numeric,
  beer_types jsonb, flavour jsonb, alternatives jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET
  origin=EXCLUDED.origin, hop_type=EXCLUDED.hop_type, description=EXCLUDED.description,
  alpha_min=EXCLUDED.alpha_min, alpha_max=EXCLUDED.alpha_max,
  beta_min=EXCLUDED.beta_min, beta_max=EXCLUDED.beta_max,
  cohumulone_min=EXCLUDED.cohumulone_min, cohumulone_max=EXCLUDED.cohumulone_max,
  total_oils_min=EXCLUDED.total_oils_min, total_oils_max=EXCLUDED.total_oils_max,
  myrcene_min=EXCLUDED.myrcene_min, myrcene_max=EXCLUDED.myrcene_max,
  humulene_min=EXCLUDED.humulene_min, humulene_max=EXCLUDED.humulene_max,
  caryophyllene_min=EXCLUDED.caryophyllene_min, caryophyllene_max=EXCLUDED.caryophyllene_max,
  farnesene_min=EXCLUDED.farnesene_min, farnesene_max=EXCLUDED.farnesene_max,
  beer_types=EXCLUDED.beer_types, flavour=EXCLUDED.flavour, alternatives=EXCLUDED.alternatives
RETURNING id;

-- One card per variety, generated FROM ref.hops so row and card cannot drift.
-- Open bounds render through ref.f_range_text as "up to 47%", never "0-47%".
WITH parts AS (
  SELECT h.name,
         concat_ws(E'\n',
           format('%s — hop%s%s', h.name,
                  CASE WHEN h.origin IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || h.origin || ')' ELSE '' END,
                  CASE WHEN h.hop_type IS NOT NULL THEN ' · ' || h.hop_type ELSE '' END),
           h.description,
           nullif(concat_ws(', ',
             'Alpha acid '      || ref.f_range_text(h.alpha_min, h.alpha_max),
             'Beta acid '       || ref.f_range_text(h.beta_min, h.beta_max),
             'Cohumulone '      || ref.f_range_text(h.cohumulone_min, h.cohumulone_max)
           ), ''),
           nullif(concat_ws(', ',
             'Total oils '      || ref.f_range_text(h.total_oils_min, h.total_oils_max, ' ml/100g'),
             'Myrcene '         || ref.f_range_text(h.myrcene_min, h.myrcene_max),
             'Humulene '        || ref.f_range_text(h.humulene_min, h.humulene_max),
             'Caryophyllene '   || ref.f_range_text(h.caryophyllene_min, h.caryophyllene_max),
             'Farnesene '       || ref.f_range_text(h.farnesene_min, h.farnesene_max)
           ), ''),
           CASE WHEN cardinality(h.flavour) > 0
                THEN 'Flavour and scent: ' || array_to_string(h.flavour, ', ') END,
           CASE WHEN cardinality(h.beer_types) > 0
                THEN 'Typical beer types: ' || array_to_string(h.beer_types, ', ') END,
           CASE WHEN cardinality(h.alternatives) > 0
                THEN 'Alternative hops: ' || array_to_string(h.alternatives, ', ') END
         ) AS body
  FROM ref.hops h
)
INSERT INTO kb.chunks
  (version_id, chunk_index, content, raw_content, heading_path,
   page_from, page_to, token_count, content_sha256)
SELECT $1::bigint,
       (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY name) - 1)::int,
       array_to_string(ARRAY['Hop Varieties', name], ' > ') || E'\n' || body,
       body,
       ARRAY['Hop Varieties', name],
       NULL::int, NULL::int, NULL::int,
       encode(sha256(convert_to(body, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
FROM parts
ON CONFLICT (version_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET
  content        = EXCLUDED.content,
  raw_content    = EXCLUDED.raw_content,
  heading_path   = EXCLUDED.heading_path,
  content_sha256 = EXCLUDED.content_sha256
RETURNING chunk_index;
